title: Cognitive Diagrams: Reviewing Categorical Accounts of Linguistic Case
description: The deposited 2.7.0 manuscript reviews categorical approaches to linguistic case using deliberately small executable examples. It distinguishes generated derivations, finite score distributions, presentation statistics and model-unit prediction errors from stronger mathematical or physiological claims. It reports 1883 tests across 94 files and 33 source-generated figures, while all numerical illustrations use synthetic inputs. No corpus study, participant experiment, EEG fit, quantum-hardware run or deployed-agent security evaluation is reported; this catalog refresh does not reproduce the reported software results.
